name: AKB1/48: Idol to Guam de Koishitara...
original_name: AKB1/48 アイドルとグアムで恋したら・・・
source:
Dating is something the AKB girls are not allowed to do. But for you, they are going to make an exception. This summer, the girls invite you to the tropical paradise Guam, all you need to do when you get there is to spend time with them and choose your one dream girl from 48.

The game boasts the largest set of heroines in a dating game. To gain your attention and affections, the girls are going to put on their bikinis and their summer dresses. The game becomes sexier, and the girls are more daring. Choosing one girl poses no difficulty, but do you have the heart to reject the rest 47 girls?
translation:
AKB成員本來嚴禁戀愛，但她們願意為你破例。這個夏天，女孩們邀請你前往熱帶天堂關島。抵達後，你只需與她們共度時光，再從48人中選出唯一的夢中情人。

本作擁有戀愛遊戲史上首屈一指的龐大女主角陣容。為了贏得你的關注與愛意，女孩們將換上比基尼與夏日洋裝。遊戲變得更加性感，她們也會表現得更加大膽。選中一個女孩並不難，但你忍心拒絕其餘47人嗎？
